int_name: E HUNTING PARK AVE & M ST

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and continuous sidewalks, providing a baseline level of safety. However, the wide roadway and presence of parked vehicles near the crossing points create potential visibility hazards and long exposure times for pedestrians in this residential area.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the side street may block the sightlines between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the side street near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry appears to allow for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, increasing the risk of conflict with pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines at the intersection.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and sidewalks, but the roadway is notably wide with significant crossing exposure. The lack of a median refuge or curb extensions increases the time pedestrians spend in the path of vehicles on this multi-lane thoroughfare.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway creates a long unprotected crossing distance, increasing pedestrian exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the width of the main roadway at the foreground crosswalk.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners may block the visibility of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, adjacent to the crosswalk entrance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a mixed-use residential area with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and traffic lights are present, the lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and the presence of parked cars near the crossing reduce overall safety and visibility.

hazards.name: Parked cars near intersection
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street are very close to the crosswalk, potentially obstructing the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The intersection is controlled by traffic lights, but no dedicated pedestrian signals are visible, which can lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: On the traffic signal poles at the corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Adding dedicated signals for pedestrians would clarify right-of-way and improve safety at this signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Implement Daylighting
interventions.description: Removing parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk would improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Constructing bulb-outs would shorten the crossing distance and prevent cars from parking too close to the intersection.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides in a mixed-use area. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals or curb extensions increase exposure for people crossing.
